failure_or_lesson: An asyncio timeout or a numeric timeout field cannot by itself wake a driver blocked on a server response. Retain the original socket open-file description and shut that description down on an actual deadline, never a potentially recycled descriptor. Cancellation cannot return a concurrency slot before physical driver/watchdog cleanup. libpq treats a one-second connect timeout as two seconds, and DNS/multihost lookup can escape a simple budget; require one explicit numeric endpoint and sufficient remaining connection allowance. Late watchdog cleanup must retain its duplicate and slot rather than permit unbounded detached watchdogs. A driver close exception is not evidence that its descriptor retired. Shut down retained traffic and keep the slot sealed on that unproven cleanup rather than accumulate leaked driver descriptors. Cleanup before wrapper ownership is established needs the same physical-retirement rule: Thread.start failure plus a raising driver close must not restore the opener slot while the original socket can still carry traffic.
